objective: Gate 7 paso 1: auditar el contrato real de navegacion/menu SQL canonico y descubrimiento operativo para Cavas Corporativas antes de insertar o modificar registros. Descubrir tablas, columnas, jerarquias, rutas, modulos, permisos y asignaciones por contexto/unidad relacionadas con menus, navegacion y Cavas. No escribir SQL ni repositorio.

queries.name: menu_navigation_candidate_tables
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE' AND (LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%menu%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%naveg%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%modul%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%permiso%') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: menu_navigation_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND (LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%menu%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%naveg%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%modul%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%permiso%') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: canonical_modules_cavas_related
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 * FROM dbo.Usuario_Modulos WHERE LOWER(CodigoModulo) LIKE '%cava%' OR LOWER(CodigoModulo) LIKE '%corpor%' ORDER BY CodigoModulo

queries.name: canonical_actions_active
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 * FROM dbo.Usuario_Acciones WHERE Activo=1 ORDER BY CodigoAccion

queries.name: menu_like_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%menu%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%naveg%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%modul%') ORDER BY o.type_desc, s.name, o.name
